articles.title_en: Gender transition and labor market outcomes: A sibling-based comparison of transgender individuals in Sweden
articles.title_cn: 性别转变与劳动力市场结果：基于兄弟姐妹比较的瑞典跨性别者研究
articles.abstract_en: This study provides the first evidence of labor market outcome disparities between transgender individuals and their siblings in Europe, utilizing comprehensive Swedish population register data from 2002 to 2022. Focusing on a cohort of over 1100 transgender individuals who underwent legal gender changes between 2013 and 2021, I employ a difference-in-differences design comparing transgender individuals to their cisgender siblings before and after legal gender change. The analysis reveals significant disparities in employment and labor income. Transgender individuals are less likely to be employed and earn lower labor incomes than their cisgender siblings. Moreover, transgender women experience a decline in their employment following legal gender changes relative to their cisgender brothers. Results suggest that industry sorting contributes to these disparities, as transgender individuals are more likely to work in lower-paying, female-dominated industries than cisgender men. Following legal gender changes, transgender women tend to leave male-dominated industries such as construction, while transgender men are more likely to enter gender-balanced industries like service sectors. The findings in this paper highlight the economic vulnerabilities experienced by transgender individuals in Sweden and emphasize the need for targeted policy interventions to reduce these inequalities.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究利用瑞典从2002至2022的全面人口登记数据，提供了欧洲跨性别者与其兄弟姐妹之间劳动力市场结果差异的首个证据。研究聚焦于1100多名在2013至2021期间经历合法性别变更的跨性别者群体，采用双重差分设计，比较跨性别者与其顺性别兄弟姐妹在合法性别变更前后的差异。分析揭示了就业和劳动收入方面的显著差异。跨性别者相比其顺性别兄弟姐妹，就业可能性更低，劳动收入也更少。此外，跨性别女性在合法性别变更后，相对于其顺性别兄弟，就业率有所下降。结果表明，行业选择是造成这些差异的因素之一，因为跨性别者比顺性别男性更可能从事低薪、女性主导的行业。在合法性别变更后，跨性别女性倾向于离开建筑等男性主导行业，而跨性别男性则更可能进入服务等性别均衡行业。本文的研究结果凸显了瑞典跨性别者所面临的经济脆弱性，并强调了采取针对性政策干预以减少这些不平等的必要性。

articles.title_en: The mismeasurement of work time: Implications for wage differentials and inequality
articles.title_cn: 工作时间测量的误差：对工资差异和不平等的影响
articles.abstract_en: Comparing measures of work time in the 1978–2018 CPS-ASEC data file (based on long-term recall) with contemporaneous measures from the Basic CPS reveals logical inconsistencies. About 8 percent of ASEC respondents report weeks worked last year that contradict their work histories in the Basic interviews. The discrepancy is over 50 percent among workers who move in and out of the workforce across monthly interviews. Over 20 percent give contradictory information about whether they usually work a full-time weekly schedule (35 or more hours per week). The levels and trends differ by gender and race and affect the calculation of wage differentials. Adjusting for the measurement discrepancies, gender wage gaps among all workers narrowed by 4 log-points more than is commonly reported, and residual wage inequality decreased by 8 log-points more among women. Smaller differences exist in measured wage gaps and residual wage inequality among full-time year-round workers.
articles.abstract_cn: 比较1978-2018 CPS-ASEC数据文件中的工作时间测量（基于长期回忆）与基本CPS的同期测量，揭示了逻辑上的不一致。大约8%的ASEC受访者报告的去年工作周数与其在基本访谈中的工作历史相矛盾。在每月访谈中进出劳动力市场的工人中，差异超过50%。超过20%的受访者提供了关于他们是否通常全职工作周（每周35小时或更多）的矛盾信息。水平和趋势因性别和种族而异，并影响工资差异的计算。调整测量差异后，所有工人中的性别工资差距缩小了4个对数点，比通常报道的更多，女性中的残差工资不平等减少了8个对数点。在全年全职工人中，测量的工资差距和残差工资不平等存在较小差异。

articles.title_en: Misclassification in linear-in-means models: Theory and application to peer effects estimation
articles.title_cn: 线性均值模型中的误分类：理论与同伴效应估计应用
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates how misclassification affects the estimation of peer effects in linear-in-means (LIM) models. We formally show that the peer effect estimate is biased by an ”own effect” due to error in the group average and a smearing effect due to misclassification in the individual regressor. The direction of the total bias depends on how misclassification is distributed across groups. We develop a simple heuristic based on the ratio of the estimated peer effect to the estimated individual effect to help researchers identify the likely direction of the total bias. We verify the theoretical predictions in the setting of peer effects of students with learning disabilities on other students’ performance.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了误分类如何影响线性均值（LIM）模型中同伴效应的估计。我们正式表明，由于群体平均值中的误差，同伴效应估计受到“自身效应”的偏误，以及由于个体回归变量中的误分类而产生的涂抹效应。总偏误的方向取决于误分类在各群体间的分布。我们开发了一个基于估计的同伴效应与估计的个体效应之比的简单启发式方法，以帮助研究者识别总偏误的可能方向。我们在有学习障碍的学生对其他学生表现的同伴效应情境中验证了理论预测。

articles.title_en: The end of work feels near. How do people perceive the impact of digital technologies and automation?
articles.title_cn: 工作终结的感觉临近。人们如何看待数字技术和自动化的影响？
articles.abstract_en: Anxieties about technological change in the context of the labor market are a recurring historical phenomenon. Using customized survey data collected in 2019 in the US and Germany, prior to the recent wave of generative AI applications, we study how respondents perceive the impact of the digital (automation) technologies available at the time of the survey on the labor market. We document that a majority views digital technologies and automation as a major threat to overall employment and as a cause of rising inequality, while a quarter is concerned about their own labor market prospects. Providing scientific information on the likely labor market implications of digital technologies in a randomized experiment reduces these concerns. Yet, treatment responses depend on prior beliefs about the future of work, resulting in heterogeneous and opposing treatment effects on policy demand.
articles.abstract_cn: 关于劳动力市场背景下技术变革的焦虑是一种反复出现的历史现象。利用在2019于美国和德国收集的定制调查数据，在近期生成式人工智能应用浪潮之前，我们研究了受访者如何感知调查时可用的数字（自动化）技术对劳动力市场的影响。我们记录到，大多数人将数字技术和自动化视为对整体就业的主要威胁以及不平等加剧的原因，而四分之一的人则担心自己的劳动力市场前景。在一项随机实验中，提供关于数字技术可能对劳动力市场影响的科学信息减少了这些担忧。然而，处理效应取决于先前对工作未来的信念，导致对政策需求产生异质且相反的处理效应。

articles.title_en: The origins of the gender pay gap: Education and job characteristics
articles.title_cn: 性别工资差距的起源：教育与工作特征
articles.abstract_en: This paper analyses the role that field of study choices and firm and job characteristics play in explaining gender pay gaps among university graduates at the beginning of their careers. We exploit a unique administrative population-wide dataset for Italy. We find that choices of university majors alone explain about half of the early-career gender pay gap, since women tend to graduate in fields that give access to lower-paying firms and jobs. Sorting across firms and jobs conditional on premarket specialization only accounts for 20% of the gap, indicating that its role is largely mediated by field choices made while still in education.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文分析了专业选择以及企业和工作特征在解释大学毕业生职业生涯初期性别工资差距中的作用。我们利用了意大利独特的行政全人口数据集。我们发现，仅大学专业选择就能解释职业生涯早期性别工资差距的大约一半，因为女性往往毕业于那些能进入薪酬较低企业和工作的专业。在考虑市场前专业化的情况下，企业和工作间的分类仅占差距的20%，这表明其作用在很大程度上是由在校期间所做的专业选择所中介的。

articles.title_en: An Evaluation of a National Program to Reduce Student Absenteeism in High School
articles.title_cn: 挪威减少高中生缺勤国家项目的评估
articles.abstract_en: Starting in the 2016/17 academic year, high school students in Norway who missed more than 10 percent of hours in a given course without a medical excuse could not receive a final grade. Across all students, the new policy reduced total absence by 21-28 percent, and chronic absence by 29-39 percent. This behavioral response was largely sufficient to avoid the academic penalty for absence over the 10 percent threshold. We also find the policy had a positive impact on teacher awarded GPA for groups with larger baseline absence and greater absolute changes in attendance.
articles.abstract_cn: 从2016/17学年开始，挪威高中学生在某一课程中无故缺勤超过10%小时将无法获得最终成绩。在所有学生中，新政策使总缺勤率降低了21-28%，长期缺勤率降低了29-39%。这种行为反应在很大程度上足以避免因缺勤超过10%阈值而受到的学业处罚。我们还发现，对于基线缺勤较多且出勤绝对变化较大的群体，该政策对教师评定的平均绩点产生了积极影响。

articles.title_en: Poverty, hardship, and government transfers
articles.title_cn: 贫困、困难与政府转移支付
articles.abstract_en: We examine how the economic well-being of those with few resources changed between 2015 and 2022, a time of economic disruption and large, transitory government transfers. We focus on changes in income and consumption-based measures of poverty and measures of material hardship for adults and children, relying on established datasets with income, consumption, asset and well-being measures. We find that in the years leading up to the pandemic and in 2020, the patterns for income and consumption poverty were very similar. In 2021 and 2022, however, changes in income and consumption poverty were quite different—consumption poverty fell less than income poverty in 2021, and then income poverty rose sharply in 2022 while consumption poverty continued to decline. This striking difference between income and consumption poverty measures echoes the low marginal propensity to consume out of pandemic spending that others have documented, providing a good case study of when such measures will diverge. Consistent with these results, we find increased saving during the pandemic followed by dissaving, even among those near the poverty line. This finding indicates that permanent income models can even be relevant when low-income households, that typically have very limited saving, receive very large transitory payments. We show that expanded Unemployment Insurance and Economic Impact (Stimulus) Payments played a larger role than the Child Tax Credit (CTC) in the decline in income poverty in 2021 and its subsequent rise in 2022. Reports of hardships rose in 2022, suggesting increased concern about financial well-being as several COVID-era transfer programs expired, with most measures similar for households with and without children.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考察了在2015至2022期间，即经济动荡和大量临时性政府转移支付时期，资源匮乏者的经济福祉如何变化。我们重点关注基于收入和消费的贫困衡量指标的变化，以及成人和儿童的物质困难指标，依赖于包含收入、消费、资产和福祉指标的既有数据集。我们发现，在疫情前的几年以及2020年，收入和消费贫困的模式非常相似。然而，在2021和2022年，收入和消费贫困的变化却大相径庭——2021年消费贫困的下降幅度小于收入贫困，随后2022年收入贫困急剧上升，而消费贫困则持续下降。收入贫困与消费贫困衡量指标之间的这种显著差异，呼应了其他人所记录的疫情支出中较低的边际消费倾向，为这些指标何时会出现分歧提供了一个很好的案例研究。与这些结果一致，我们发现疫情期间储蓄增加，随后出现负储蓄，即使在贫困线附近的人群中也是如此。这一发现表明，永久收入模型即使在低收入家庭（通常储蓄非常有限）收到大量临时性支付时也可能具有相关性。我们表明，扩大的失业保险和经济影响（刺激）支付在2021年收入贫困下降及其随后在2022年上升中所起的作用大于儿童税收抵免（CTC）。2022年困难报告有所增加，表明随着几项疫情时期的转移支付项目到期，人们对财务福祉的担忧加剧，大多数指标在有子女和无子女的家庭中相似。

articles.title_en: The local economic impact of international students: Evidence from US commuting zones
articles.title_cn: 国际学生的本地经济影响：来自美国通勤区的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the impact of international students on local labor markets and establishments in the United States. Identification rests on a shift-share instrumental variable strategy that exploits supply-driven changes in foreign enrollment in non-US destinations. I find that one additional international student per thousand working-age residents increases the employment-to-population ratio by 0.19 percentage points and average hourly wages by 0.48 percent. Increases in foreign enrollment also lead to substantial labor reallocations toward potentially more productive establishments, particularly within non-tradable industries. Heterogeneity analyses suggest that these effects are primarily driven by demand-side factors related to student spending, while labor supply contributions from student employment play a limited role. Overall, these findings point to sizable economic benefits linked to foreign student inflows through increased local income and business dynamism, and suggest that rising trade tensions and restrictive immigration policies may impose substantial costs by slowing or reversing recent enrollment trends.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了国际学生对美国本地劳动力市场和企业的影响。识别策略依赖于一种转移份额工具变量方法，该方法利用了非美国目的地外国入学人数的供给驱动变化。我发现，每千名工作年龄居民中每增加一名国际学生，就业人口比就会提高0.19个百分点，平均小时工资提高0.48%。外国入学人数的增加还导致劳动力向可能更具生产力的企业进行实质性重新配置，尤其是在非贸易行业内部。异质性分析表明，这些效应主要由与学生支出相关的需求侧因素驱动，而学生就业的劳动力供给贡献作用有限。总体而言，这些发现表明，外国学生流入通过增加本地收入和商业活力带来了可观的经济效益，并暗示不断升级的贸易紧张局势和限制性移民政策可能通过减缓或逆转近期入学趋势而带来巨大成本。

articles.title_en: Keeping it in the family: Student to degree match
articles.title_cn: 家庭传承：学生与学位匹配
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines systematic inequalities in the sorting of students to university degree programs with regards to first-in-family (FIF) to attend university and gender. Using linked administrative data on the population of Portuguese applicants, we document that FIF students consistently match to lower quality degrees across the entire achievement distribution, while only the highest achieving female students relatively undermatch. Then, leveraging Portugal’s deferred acceptance centralized admissions system, we establish that these enrollment gaps are due to differences in student application patterns. We show these gaps remain after accounting for measurement error in student quality, through alternate measures and a lagged instrument approach. The paper concludes by exploring which factors do account for the gaps, finding that initial location explains much of the FIF gap, and degree subject closes the gender gap.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了在家庭第一代（FIF）上大学和性别方面，学生与大学学位课程匹配中的系统性不平等。利用葡萄牙申请者总体的关联行政数据，我们记录了FIF学生在整个成绩分布中始终匹配到较低质量的学位，而只有成绩最高的女学生相对低配。然后，利用葡萄牙的延迟接受集中录取制度，我们确定这些入学差距是由于学生申请模式的差异所致。我们表明，在通过替代测量和滞后工具变量方法考虑学生质量的测量误差后，这些差距仍然存在。本文最后探讨了哪些因素确实解释了这些差距，发现初始位置解释了FIF差距的大部分，而学位学科则缩小了性别差距。

articles.title_en: Work disability after motherhood: How paternity leave can help
articles.title_cn: 产后工作残疾：陪产假如何发挥作用
articles.abstract_en: We examine how the provision of paternity leave can reduce the time mothers spend on disability insurance after childbirth. Using Belgian administrative data and a Regression Discontinuity Design around a July 2002 reform, we estimate that mothers whose partners became eligible for a statutory paternity leave spent, on average, 13% fewer days on disability over the following twelve years. We provide suggestive evidence that paternity leave affects maternal long-run disability through (1) increased fathers’ involvement in child care, resulting in more child-free time for mothers; and (2) longer waiting time before having a second child.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了陪产假的提供如何减少母亲在分娩后领取残疾保险的时间。利用比利时行政数据以及围绕七月2002改革进行的断点回归设计，我们估计，其伴侣有资格享受法定陪产假的母亲，在接下来的十二年中，平均在残疾保险上的天数减少了13%天。我们提供了提示性证据，表明陪产假通过（1）增加父亲在育儿中的参与，从而为母亲带来更多无子女时间；以及（2）延长生育第二个孩子前的等待时间，来影响母亲的长期残疾状况。

articles.title_en: Labor market effects of the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act
articles.title_cn: 《减税与就业法案》的劳动力市场效应
articles.abstract_en: The Tax Cuts and Jobs Act (TCJA) of 2017 represents the most significant reform of the U.S. income tax code since the Tax Reform Act of 1986. Previous analyses of the TCJA’s economic impact often rely on estimates based on data prior to the enactment of the legislation. This paper leverages plausibly exogenous variations in state-level tax changes brought about by the TCJA and employs local projections with two-way fixed effects to examine its effects on the labor market. Measures of TCJA tax shocks are constructed with the NBER-TAXSIM model using state-level tabulations of individual income tax returns from the Statistics of Income (SOI). Our findings suggest that tax cuts amounting to 1 percent of Adjusted Gross Income (AGI) under the TCJA are associated with a 0.7–1 percentage point increase in the labor force participation rate (LFPR) and a 0.8–1.5 percent increase in payroll employment over the two years following the TCJA’s implementation. These results appear broadly robust to assumptions about heterogeneous state responses and the inclusion of interactive fixed effects.
articles.abstract_cn: 2017年的《减税与就业法案》（TCJA）代表了自1986年《税制改革法案》以来美国所得税法最重大的改革。以往对TCJA经济影响的分析往往依赖于基于该法案颁布前数据的估计。本文利用TCJA带来的州级税收变化中看似外生的变动，并采用具有双向固定效应的局部投影法来考察其对劳动力市场的影响。TCJA税收冲击的度量是通过NBER-TAXSIM模型，使用来自收入统计（SOI）的州级个人所得税申报表汇总构建的。我们的研究结果表明，在TCJA实施后的两年内，相当于调整后总收入（AGI）1%的减税与劳动力参与率（LFPR）提高0.7-1以及工资就业增加0.8-1.5%相关。这些结果在关于州异质性反应和包含交互固定效应的假设下大体上是稳健的。

articles.title_en: Predicting retirement and Social Security claiming decisions using machine learning
articles.title_cn: 使用机器学习预测退休和社会保障申领决策
articles.abstract_en: Accurate forecasts of retirement and Social Security (SS) claiming behavior are important for projecting the long-run costs of public pension and social-insurance systems. We study whether machine learning methods, applied to a rich set of household-level variables, can improve predictions of retirement and SS claiming decisions. Our model predicts the share of SS beneficiaries with an error of less than 1 percentage point, while the benchmark model used by the Social Security Administration (SSA) has an error of more than 3 percentage points. A conservative calculation implies that this difference corresponds to about 35.16 billion dollars per year in aggregate benefits. In a 2020 forecasting exercise using models trained on pre-2018 data, our model retains strong predictive performance during COVID-19 and outperforms the SSA benchmark. We also find that our model performs better across groups defined by expected SS benefits, with especially large gains among individuals with high expected benefits. In addition, the variables selected by our model differ from those emphasized in the SSA benchmark. Using Shapley values, we show that variable contributions are often nonlinear.
articles.abstract_cn: 退休和社会保障（SS）申领行为的准确预测对于预测公共养老金和社会保险体系的长期成本至关重要。我们研究了将机器学习方法应用于丰富的家庭层面变量，是否能改进对退休和SS申领决策的预测。我们的模型预测SS受益人的比例误差小于1个百分点，而社会保障管理局（SSA）使用的基准模型误差超过3个百分点。保守计算表明，这一差异相当于每年约35.16十亿美元的总体福利。在使用2018年前数据训练的模型进行的2020预测练习中，我们的模型在COVID-19期间保持了强大的预测性能，并优于SSA基准。我们还发现，我们的模型在按预期SS福利划分的群体中表现更好，尤其是在预期福利较高的个体中收益显著。此外，我们的模型选择的变量与SSA基准强调的变量不同。使用Shapley值，我们表明变量贡献通常是非线性的。

articles.title_en: Public childcare and maternal employment in Brazil
articles.title_cn: 公共托儿服务与巴西母亲就业
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the impact of formal childcare use on maternal labor market outcomes. By combining Brazilian census data with administrative records on public childcare demand and supply in São Paulo, discontinuities in childcare shortages across birth cohorts and neighborhoods are exploited. This variation enables an identification strategy that compares observationally equivalent mothers within the same neighborhood who differ only in their likelihood of obtaining a public childcare slot. Among mothers induced into formal care by public provision, access to center-based care significantly increases employment, full-time work, and formal sector participation. The effects of formal childcare use on other household members, including partners and older children, are also examined, though the estimates are largely imprecise. Finally, a discrete choice model is estimated to evaluate counterfactual allocations of new public childcare centers. Policies targeting neighborhood income or excess demand yield similar gains in maternal employment and achieve roughly 60% of the employment effects of the optimal allocation.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了正式托儿服务使用对母亲劳动力市场结果的影响。通过将巴西人口普查数据与圣保罗公共托儿服务需求与供给的行政记录相结合，利用了不同出生队列和社区之间托儿服务短缺的不连续性。这一变化使得一种识别策略成为可能，该策略比较了同一社区内观察上相似的母亲，她们仅在获得公共托儿名额的可能性上有所不同。在因公共供给而被诱导进入正式托儿服务的母亲中，获得中心式托儿服务显著提高了就业率、全职工作率和正规部门参与率。本文还考察了正式托儿服务使用对其他家庭成员（包括伴侣和年长子女）的影响，尽管估计结果大多不精确。最后，估计了一个离散选择模型，以评估新公共托儿中心的反事实分配。针对社区收入或超额需求的政策在母亲就业方面产生相似的收益，并实现了最优分配就业效应的约60%。

articles.title_en: The rise of work from home and its impact on job satisfaction
articles.title_cn: 居家办公的兴起及其对工作满意度的影响
articles.abstract_en: The COVID-19 pandemic induced dramatic changes in work arrangements, most notably through a sharp expansion of working from home (WFH). Starting in 2021, we fielded annual surveys on WFH in a nationally representative, probability-based panel. Using these data, we employ three complementary empirical strategies to estimate the impact of WFH on worker wellbeing. First, using discrete choice experiments, we elicit workers’ willingness to pay for additional days of WFH and show that remote work is a highly valued job amenity. Second, using pooled OLS and individual fixed-effects regressions, we document that workers who are allowed to work from home report significantly higher job satisfaction. Third, exploiting the pandemic-induced shift to WFH, we document that workers in jobs amenable to WFH at the onset of the pandemic experienced a relative increase in satisfaction compared to workers in non-amenable jobs; this effect persists and remains statistically significant several years after the pandemic’s onset. All three approaches consistently point to WFH as a valuable non-monetary job amenity. Because access to WFH expanded disproportionately across the socioeconomic distribution, the pandemic-induced shift toward remote work disproportionately benefited higher-socioeconomic-status workers.
articles.abstract_cn: COVID-19疫情引发了工作安排的巨大变化，最显著的是居家办公（WFH）的急剧扩张。从2021年开始，我们在一个具有全国代表性、基于概率的固定样本中，对居家办公进行了年度调查。利用这些数据，我们采用三种互补的实证策略来估计居家办公对劳动者福祉的影响。首先，通过离散选择实验，我们得出劳动者对额外居家办公天数的支付意愿，并表明远程工作是一项被高度重视的工作福利。其次，利用混合OLS和个体固定效应回归，我们记录了被允许居家办公的劳动者报告的工作满意度显著更高。第三，利用疫情引发的居家办公转变，我们记录了在疫情初期适合居家办公的工作岗位上的劳动者，其满意度相对于不适合居家办公岗位的劳动者有所提高；这一效应在疫情爆发数年后依然存在且具有统计显著性。这三种方法一致表明，居家办公是一种有价值的非货币性工作福利。由于居家办公的可及性在社会经济分布中不成比例地扩大，疫情引发的远程工作转变不成比例地惠及了社会经济地位较高的劳动者。

articles.title_en: The returns to host-country college for immigrants
articles.title_cn: 移民在东道国接受大学教育的回报
articles.abstract_en: This study estimates the causal effect of access to college for adult immigrants. I utilize that immigrants must demonstrate their language proficiency to enroll in college and estimate the effect of college access by comparing those who just passed to those who just failed the test. Passing the test raises the proportion of immigrants who graduate from college at the expense of shorter educations. This change in skill investments increases earnings by 19% while not affecting average employment or work hours and is in part driven by job shifts towards high-skilled jobs. For the immigrants on the margin of passing the language test, the earnings effects outweigh the incremental costs of education.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究估计了成年移民获得大学教育机会的因果效应。我利用移民必须证明其语言能力才能进入大学这一条件，通过比较刚好通过和刚好未通过语言测试的移民来估计大学教育机会的影响。通过测试提高了移民中大学毕业的比例，但以缩短教育年限为代价。这种技能投资的变化使收入增加了19%，同时不影响平均就业率或工作时间，部分原因是向高技能工作的职业转移。对于处于语言测试通过边缘的移民，收入效应超过了教育的增量成本。

articles.title_en: The consequences of state policy ideology for education and inequality
articles.title_cn: 国家政策意识形态对教育与不平等的影响
articles.abstract_en: In this paper, I examine the impact of state policy liberalism on educational attainment and income inequality from 1947 to 2014. Using an instrumental variable strategy that leverages U.S. states’ varied responses to shifts in federal ideology, I find that state policy liberalism has increased the college graduation rate by 18 percent. Contrary to conventional wisdom, however, state policy liberalism has an ambiguous effect on income inequality that depends on the college wage premium. The findings are consistent with a theoretical model in which intergenerationally motivated voters support redistributive and educational policies.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我考察了从1947到2014期间国家政策自由主义对教育成就和收入不平等的影响。利用利用美国各州对联邦意识形态转变的不同反应的工具变量策略，我发现国家政策自由主义使大学毕业生率提高了18%。然而，与传统观念相反，国家政策自由主义对收入不平等的影响是模糊的，取决于大学工资溢价。这些发现与一个理论模型一致，在该模型中，代际动机的选民支持再分配和教育政策。

articles.title_en: Overqualification and the child penalty: Unpacking gender mismatch gaps in the UK
articles.title_cn: 过度资格与育儿惩罚：英国性别错配差距的分解
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies gender differences in labour market mismatch, over-education and over-skilling in the UK using two waves of the OECD Survey of Adult Skills (PIAAC) from 2012 and 2023. We construct six mismatch indicators and estimate adjusted gender mismatch gaps using double/debiased machine learning paired with stacked generalisation. In the full sample, the gap is largely explained by observable characteristics, but this masks a pronounced heterogeneity by parenthood: the adjusted gap is negligible among childless workers and large and persistent among parents. We show that this gap reflects motherhood-induced occupational re-sorting, which intensifies over the life cycle and is concentrated in inflexible industries. Over time, the skill-based component of the gap has narrowed substantially, while the credential-based component has not, suggesting that recent UK family policies have operated on the time-cost margin of skill use but not on the allocation of workers across jobs with different formal requirements.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用2012和2023两轮OECD成人技能调查（PIAAC）数据，研究了英国劳动力市场错配、过度教育和过度技能方面的性别差异。我们构建了六个错配指标，并使用双重/去偏机器学习结合堆叠泛化方法估计了调整后的性别错配差距。在全样本中，该差距在很大程度上可由可观测特征解释，但这掩盖了育儿状态带来的显著异质性：调整后的差距在无子女工人中可忽略不计，而在父母中则较大且持续存在。我们表明，这一差距反映了母亲身份导致的职业重新排序，这种排序在生命周期中加剧，并集中在灵活性较低的行业。随着时间的推移，基于技能的差距部分已大幅缩小，而基于资质的差距部分则没有，这表明英国近期的家庭政策作用于技能使用的时间成本边际，而未作用于工人在不同正式要求岗位间的配置。

articles.title_en: Learning in creative tasks: Evidence from a digital platform
articles.title_cn: 创造性任务中的学习：来自数字平台的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper explores learning-by-doing in the context of creative tasks using detailed data on fiction writers from a digital publishing platform. I construct measures to quantify authors’ performance over time and document significant variation in both starting levels and rates of improvement. Learning manifests as an improvement in quality instead of the speed of production. Writers improve slowly at the beginning, but quality improvement can last for several years, much longer than typically observed in manufacturing settings.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用数字出版平台上小说作家的详细数据，探讨了创造性任务中的干中学效应。我构建了衡量作者随时间表现变化的指标，并记录了起始水平和改进速度上的显著差异。学习表现为质量的提升而非生产速度的提高。作家在初期进步缓慢，但质量提升可持续数年，远长于制造业环境中通常观察到的持续时间。

articles.title_en: Making reference-dependent preferences: Evidence from door-to-door sales
articles.title_cn: 制造参考依赖偏好：来自上门销售的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper uses data from a door-to-door sales company and an online experiment to examine the relationship between reference-dependent daily labor supply and long-run goal achievement. In the sales data, I show that daily labor supply kinks downward at a worker’s expectations and that these expectations directly correspond to bonuses paid at the end of the sales season. The bonuses induce workers to adopt long-run targets and subsequently distribute these into internalized daily goals around which they exhibit loss aversion. These dynamics explain why non-linear payment schemes increase performance: workers change their short-run behavior in response to long-run performance targets. The online experiment confirms a causal interpretation of this relationship between bonuses and short-run behavior and supports the idea that short-run reference dependence can be ”made” or induced by firms by adopting non-linear compensation schemes. These dynamics increase worker output and firm profitability and can explain why non-linear compensation is so popular in the labor market.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用一家上门销售公司的数据和一项在线实验，考察了参考依赖的日劳动供给与长期目标达成之间的关系。在销售数据中，我表明日劳动供给在工人的预期处向下弯曲，且这些预期直接对应于销售季结束时支付的奖金。奖金促使工人设定长期目标，随后将其内化为日常目标，并围绕这些目标表现出损失厌恶。这些动态解释了为何非线性支付方案能提高绩效：工人改变短期行为以响应长期绩效目标。在线实验证实了奖金与短期行为之间关系的因果解释，并支持了短期参考依赖可由企业通过采用非线性补偿方案来“制造”或诱导的观点。这些动态提高了工人的产出和企业的盈利能力，并能解释为何非线性补偿在劳动力市场中如此普遍。

articles.title_en: Cross-border labor outflows, turnover, and adjustments of firms
articles.title_cn: 跨境劳动力流出、人员流动与企业调整
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies how firm adjustment to outflows of workers depends on the state of the local labor market and possibly the shock size. My difference-in-differences analysis leverages the gradual liberalization of the Swiss labor market for EU citizens, that generated an exogenous negative labor supply shock for Italian firms, with treatment intensity defined by their distance from the border. Using detailed social security data, I document a large outflow of workers and a sharp increase in turnover. In smaller, more constrained labor markets close to the border, surviving firms suffer immediate productivity losses and later adopt a cost-saving strategy by mitigating wage growth. In contrast, firms in wider markets further from the border, facing a weaker shock, do not experience a decline in productivity and are able to increase wages for incumbent workers. The negative effects are concentrated in high-skill intensive firms, consistent with higher turnover costs and the loss of firm-specific human capital in smaller labor markets. These outcomes can be rationalized within a standard competitive model in the presence of labor market imperfections.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了企业对劳动力流出的调整如何取决于当地劳动力市场的状况以及可能的冲击规模。我的双重差分分析利用了瑞士对欧盟公民劳动力市场逐步自由化的政策，该政策对意大利企业产生了外生的负向劳动力供给冲击，处理强度由企业距边境的距离定义。利用详细的社会保障数据，我记录了工人大量流出和人员流动率急剧上升的情况。在靠近边境、规模较小且受限更多的劳动力市场中，幸存企业立即遭受生产率损失，随后通过抑制工资增长采取成本节约策略。相比之下，在距离边境更远、市场更广阔的企业中，由于面临的冲击较弱，其生产率并未下降，且能够为在职员工提高工资。负面效应集中在高技能密集型企业中，这与较小劳动力市场中更高的人员流动成本和企业特定人力资本的损失相一致。这些结果可以在存在劳动力市场不完善的标准竞争模型中得到合理解释。

articles.title_en: Let’s roll back! The challenging task of regulating temporary contracts
articles.title_cn: 让我们倒退！规范临时合同的艰巨任务
articles.abstract_en: Labour-market dualism remains a persistent feature of many European economies, raising concerns about inequality and segmentation. We study Italy’s 2018 Decreto Dignità, which increased regulatory costs for temporary contracts and narrowed the gap between temporary and permanent employment protection. Using longitudinal Labour Force Survey data, we estimate quarterly flows across several labour-market states and construct a forecast-based counterfactual from pre-reform dynamics. We find a substantial rise in cumulative transitions from temporary to permanent employment and a marked decline in the persistence of temporary contracts. While unemployment falls modestly, transitions into inactivity increase. To interpret these patterns, we calibrate a simple search-and-matching model with temporary and permanent contracts. The quantitative results show that higher renewal costs and shorter contract duration explain most of the shift towards permanent employment. Overall, the findings highlight both the potential and the limits of re-regulating temporary contracts as a tool to reduce labour-market segmentation.
articles.abstract_cn: 劳动力市场二元性仍然是许多欧洲经济体的持久特征，引发了对不平等和分割的担忧。我们研究了意大利的2018《尊严法令》，该法令提高了临时合同的监管成本，并缩小了临时与永久就业保护之间的差距。利用纵向劳动力调查数据，我们估计了跨多个劳动力市场状态的季度流动，并从改革前的动态中构建了一个基于预测的反事实。我们发现，从临时就业向永久就业的累积转换显著增加，临时合同的持续性明显下降。虽然失业率略有下降，但向非活动状态的转换增加。为了解释这些模式，我们校准了一个包含临时和永久合同的简单搜索匹配模型。定量结果表明，更高的续签成本和更短的合同期限解释了向永久就业转变的大部分原因。总体而言，研究结果凸显了重新规范临时合同作为减少劳动力市场分割工具的可能性和局限性。

articles.title_en: Conditionality vs. autonomy: What works best in social assistance?
articles.title_cn: 条件性与自主性：社会救助中哪种方式效果最佳？
articles.abstract_en: We study the impacts of reducing conditionality for social assistance recipients through a field experiment in the Netherlands. Treated subjects received an exemption from job search requirements, monitoring, and sanctions or intensive counseling personalized to their needs and wishes. Our findings indicate that exemption increases employment and self-sufficiency, with effects that grow over time. The effects of counseling are smaller and not statistically significant. Using survey data, we find suggestive evidence of increased experienced autonomy, while we do not detect systematic effects on self-reported job search, social participation, health, or well-being. While the results should be interpreted with caution given a modest sample size, they provide novel experimental evidence on the role of autonomy and conditionality in social assistance.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过在荷兰进行的一项实地实验，研究了减少社会救助领取者条件性的影响。受试者获得了求职要求、监督和制裁的豁免，或根据其需求和愿望量身定制的强化咨询。我们的研究结果表明，豁免增加了就业和自给自足，且效果随时间增长。咨询的效果较小且不具有统计显著性。利用调查数据，我们发现了体验自主性增强的提示性证据，但未检测到对自我报告的求职、社会参与、健康或福祉的系统性影响。尽管鉴于样本量适中，结果应谨慎解读，但它们为自主性和条件性在社会救助中的作用提供了新颖的实验证据。

articles.title_en: The impact of credit frictions on immigrants’ labor market outcomes
articles.title_cn: 信贷摩擦对移民劳动力市场结果的影响
articles.abstract_en: Exploiting the differential effect of the USA PATRIOT Act on natives and non-citizens, I find that the Act increased credit frictions for non-citizens and was associated with a decline in their wages. I also document a decline in unemployment, although this result is sensitive to the choice of specification and may partly reflect the recovery from the 2001 recession. The estimated wage effect does not reflect occupational downgrading, sectoral reallocation, or changes in self-employment. Instead, it occurred largely within industries and occupations, consistent with non-citizens accepting lower wages for similar jobs following the increase in credit frictions. These findings suggest that credit frictions may be an important yet overlooked determinant of nativity gaps in labor market outcomes.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用《美国爱国者法案》对本土公民和非公民的差异化影响，我发现该法案增加了非公民的信贷摩擦，并与其工资下降相关。我还记录了失业率的下降，尽管这一结果对规格选择敏感，且可能部分反映了从2001衰退中的复苏。估计的工资效应并不反映职业降级、部门重新分配或自雇变化。相反，它主要发生在行业和职业内部，这与信贷摩擦增加后非公民接受类似工作的较低工资一致。这些发现表明，信贷摩擦可能是劳动力市场结果中本土出生差距的一个重要但被忽视的决定因素。
articles.abstract_snippet_en: Exploiting the differential effect of the USA PATRIOT Act on natives and non-citizens, I find that the Act increased credit frictions for non-citizens and was associated with a decline in their wages....

articles.title_en: Beggars cannot be choosers: Labor market tightness, hiring standards, wages, and hiring costs
articles.title_cn: 饥不择食：劳动力市场紧张程度、招聘标准、工资与招聘成本
articles.abstract_en: This study analyzes how hiring standards, entry wages, and hiring costs are associated with labor market tightness. Using unique linked employer–employee data for small- and medium-sized firms in Germany, we find that pre-match search costs represent only 16 percent of total hiring expenditures, while post-match costs account for the remaining 84 percent. Instrumental variable regressions show no evidence that tighter labor markets are associated with higher entry wages. Instead, we find differences along two non-wage dimensions. First, firms hire workers whose general ability is lower relative to their existing workforce. Second, firms incur higher post-match hiring costs for these hires. A one-standard-deviation increase in labor market tightness is associated with a 0.1 standard deviation decrease in hiring standards, an 11 percent longer adaptation period, and 15 percent higher informal training hours for new hires. These findings suggest that, in tight labor markets, variation in hiring outcomes is reflected more strongly in hiring standards and post-hire training investments than in entry wages.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究分析了招聘标准、入职工资和招聘成本与劳动力市场紧张程度之间的关系。利用德国中小型企业的独特关联雇主-雇员数据，我们发现匹配前搜索成本仅占招聘总支出的16%，而匹配后成本占剩余的84%。工具变量回归显示，没有证据表明更紧张的劳动力市场与更高的入职工资相关。相反，我们发现在两个非工资维度上存在差异。首先，企业招聘的工人其一般能力相对于现有员工较低。其次，企业为这些新员工承担更高的匹配后招聘成本。劳动力市场紧张程度每增加一个标准差，与招聘标准下降0.1个标准差、适应期延长11%以及新员工非正式培训时间增加15%相关。这些发现表明，在紧张的劳动力市场中，招聘结果的变化更多地反映在招聘标准和入职后培训投资上，而非入职工资上。
articles.abstract_snippet_en: This study analyzes how hiring standards, entry wages, and hiring costs are associated with labor market tightness. Using unique linked employer–employee data for small- and medium-sized firms in Germany,...

articles.title_en: Greedy work: Signaling and the design of demanding jobs
articles.title_cn: 贪婪的工作：信号传递与高要求工作的设计
articles.abstract_en: This paper develops a theory of greedy jobs in which rigid, high-intensity work arrangements arise as an equilibrium response to asymmetric information rather than as a purely technological necessity. Firms differ in their returns to demanding work, but these returns are privately known, while job demandingness is observable to workers. When workers are homogeneous, firms separate efficiently and job design reflects productivity alone. Once workers differ in their tolerance for demanding work due to caregiving responsibilities, equilibrium sorting interacts with signaling incentives: to deter imitation and attract non-caregivers, high-return firms distort job design beyond the surplus-maximizing level, generating excessively rigid jobs and higher wage premia while excluding caregivers. The framework also shows how technological convergence, caregiving-targeted innovations, and minimum flexibility requirements reshape signaling incentives, helping explain why excessively demanding jobs persist in elite labor markets and why regulation and technological progress can have ambiguous effects when job design serves as both a signal and a sorting device.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文发展了一个关于贪婪工作的理论，其中刚性、高强度的工作安排作为对信息不对称的均衡反应而出现，而非纯粹的技术必要性。企业在高要求工作的回报上存在差异，但这些回报是私人信息，而工作的要求程度对工人是可观察的。当工人是同质的时，企业会有效分离，工作设计仅反映生产率。一旦工人因照顾责任而对高要求工作的容忍度存在差异，均衡分类与信号传递激励相互作用：为了阻止模仿并吸引非照顾者，高回报企业会将工作设计扭曲到超出剩余最大化的水平，产生过度刚性的工作和更高的工资溢价，同时排斥照顾者。该框架还展示了技术趋同、针对照顾的创新以及最低灵活性要求如何重塑信号传递激励，有助于解释为什么过度要求的工作在精英劳动力市场中持续存在，以及当工作设计既作为信号又作为分类工具时，监管和技术进步为何会产生模糊效应。

articles.title_en: Gay varsity: Subject choices, grades, and early careers for UK LGB university students
articles.title_cn: 同性恋大学：英国LGB大学生的学科选择、成绩与早期职业
articles.abstract_en: Using data on UK students attending university from 2012 to 2020, we look at how LGB students differ from their heterosexual counterparts. LGB men and women both have large shifts towards Humanities subjects, and away from LEM (law, economics, management) and STEM. Gay and bisexual men do well in degree outcomes in the Humanities, and about the same as heterosexual men in other subjects. Lesbian and bisexual women do about the same as heterosexual women in the Humanities and poorly in other subjects. Male and female LGB students suffer in salaries in their early career.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用2012至2020年间英国大学生数据，我们考察了LGB学生与异性恋学生的差异。LGB男性和女性均显著倾向于人文学科，而较少选择LEM（法律、经济学、管理学）和STEM学科。男同性恋和双性恋男性在人文学科的成绩表现良好，在其他学科与异性恋男性相当。女同性恋和双性恋女性在人文学科的成绩与异性恋女性相当，但在其他学科表现较差。LGB男女学生在早期职业生涯中的薪资均较低。

articles.title_en: Public child care and mothers’ career trajectories
articles.title_cn: 公共托儿服务与母亲的职业轨迹
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies how public child care affects the quality of mothers’ careers in Germany, a setting characterized by low female labor force participation and traditional gender norms. Leveraging administrative data and quasi-experimental variation in child care expansion, we analyze occupational and employer mobility, task content, leadership, and within-firm wage positions. We show that while child care increases maternal employment, its effects on career quality are selective and context-dependent. Improvements are observed in employment in high-skilled occupations involving more complex, non-routine tasks and tend to be more pronounced among mothers in time-flexible occupations and family-friendly firms, highlighting complementarities between public policy and workplace conditions.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了在德国这一以女性劳动力参与率低和传统性别规范为特征的环境中，公共托儿服务如何影响母亲的职业质量。利用行政数据和托儿服务扩张的准实验变异，我们分析了职业和雇主流动性、任务内容、领导力以及企业内工资位置。我们表明，虽然托儿服务提高了母亲的就业率，但其对职业质量的影响是有选择性的且依赖于情境。在高技能职业中观察到就业改善，这些职业涉及更复杂的、非常规任务，并且在时间灵活的职业和家庭友好型企业中的母亲中往往更为明显，这凸显了公共政策与工作场所条件之间的互补性。

articles.title_en: Algorithmic wage setting on online labor platforms
articles.title_cn: 在线劳动力平台上的算法工资设定
articles.abstract_en: Online digital labor platforms are increasingly important as tools for matching employers and workers. They reduce labor market frictions and provide the opportunity for remote work, but concerns have been raised about whether workers receive adequate incomes. We study how the use of machine-learning based algorithms for the determination of wage offers affects workers’ wages on online labor platforms by setting up a simulation framework and analyzing outcomes under different assumptions about platform and algorithm design. Firms use reinforcement-learning to update posted wages on the platform, and heterogeneous workers send applications based on the posted information. We show that, if firms use a deep Q-network (DQN), a state-of-the-art machine learning algorithm, collusive wages emerge when the number of competitors is small, and no experience replay is used. Our findings are robust across many features of the model, including the design of the online labor platform.
articles.abstract_cn: 在线数字劳动力平台作为匹配雇主和工人的工具日益重要。它们减少了劳动力市场摩擦，并提供了远程工作的机会，但人们担心工人是否能获得足够的收入。我们通过建立一个模拟框架，并分析在平台和算法设计的不同假设下的结果，研究了基于机器学习的算法在确定工资报价时如何影响在线劳动力平台上工人的工资。企业使用强化学习来更新平台上发布的工资，而异质工人根据发布的信息发送申请。我们表明，如果企业使用深度Q网络（DQN），一种最先进的机器学习算法，当竞争对手数量较少且不使用经验回放时，会出现合谋工资。我们的发现在模型的许多特征上都是稳健的，包括在线劳动力平台的设计。

articles.title_en: The long-run impacts of parental leave policies on the motherhood penalty: Evidence from Canada
articles.title_cn: 育儿假政策对母职惩罚的长期影响：来自加拿大的证据
articles.abstract_en: Motherhood affects the earnings of women. But does the type of maternity and parental leave available at the time of first birth matter? This paper addresses this question for lower- to middle-income mothers, using Canadian tax data for the years 1997–2019 and exploiting the 2006 introduction of the Québec Parental Insurance Plan, which offered a more generous leave benefit. Using an event-study difference-in-differences approach, this paper finds no significant short-term effect on initial earnings losses. However, mothers exposed to the reform experience a larger recovery, starting from four years after the birth of their first child, which is largely driven by stronger labour market attachment.
articles.abstract_cn: 母职影响女性的收入。但首次生育时可获得的产假和育儿假类型是否重要？本文利用加拿大1997-2019年的税收数据，并利用2006年魁北克省育儿保险计划的引入（该计划提供了更慷慨的育儿假福利），来回答这一问题，研究对象为低收入至中等收入的母亲。采用事件研究双重差分方法，本文发现对初始收入损失没有显著的短期影响。然而，受改革影响的母亲在第一个孩子出生四年后开始经历更大的恢复，这主要由更强的劳动力市场依附性驱动。
